chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī Naṣr, from Jamīl, from Burayd, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

If a slave commits zina, he is struck with fifty lashes. If he repeats, he is struck with fifty lashes; and if he repeats, he is struck with fifty lashes up to eight times. Then if he commits zina eight times, he is killed, and the Imam pays his value to his masters from the Bayt al-Mal.

key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: the Imam; the governing authority who executes the ruling and pays compensation
key_terms.الْعَبْدُ: the slave; a bondsman subject here to a specified legal ruling
key_terms.بَيْتِ الْمَالِ: the public treasury; the source from which compensation is paid
key_terms.ثَمَانِيَ مَرَّاتٍ: eight times; the number of repeated offenses mentioned before execution
key_terms.خَمْسِينَ: fifty; the number of lashes prescribed in this report
key_terms.زَنَى: committed zina; engaged in unlawful sexual intercourse
key_terms.قُتِلَ: he was killed; the punishment stated after the repeated offense threshold
key_terms.قِيمَتَهُ: his value; the monetary compensation for the slave

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Tahdhib al-Ahkam on a slave who repeatedly commits zina?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the hadd punishment for a slave who commits zina repeatedly. It specifies repeated flogging of fifty lashes, and after the eighth offense, execution, with the Imam compensating the owners from the Bayt al-Mal.
